title: I made an incremental game where you have to find the original game among 5 million clones of Needle in a Haystack Simulator game 🤖
author: Daniele-Fantastico
selftext:
I just released a game I built entirely with Claude Code and a little help from ChatGPT Codex. It’s a satire of all the *Needle in a Haystack Simulator* clones that have popped up.

**Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators**

You’re browsing Vapor, a fictional video game store, trying to find the original game among 5 million clones. It’s an incremental game at heart. You start out following clues and using tools to narrow down the search. Eventually, you get bots and other ways to automate it. You also have your own 3D room, where things occasionally happen.

A few numbers from development:

* 290 prompts. Definitely more than a one-prompt game!
* Around 74 Claude Code sessions and 11 Codex sessions. I used Codex mostly for simulated playtesting.
* I used Opus 5.5 on Extra High about 96% of the time.
* 14.5 million output tokens and 3.55 billion input tokens, with 99% of the input tokens served from cache.

Codex generated 32 images for the fake games, including capsule art, screenshots, and covers. Opus created the game icon and achievement icons as SVGs and synthesized the sound effects and music.

Claude and Codex simulated thousands of playthroughs to estimate what a typical player would do and how long it would take. One thing the simulations often got wrong was human reaction time. So I recorded several playthroughs of my own, and Claude used those recordings to build more reliable automated playtests.

I had a lot of fun making this.  
If you’ve got questions about how any of it came together, ask away!

The game:  
[https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/5521470](https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/5521470)

comments.author: AdrianaImai
comments.body: I played your game. It’s not too bad. Took about an hour and a half to beat and had some issues, but it was worth the money in my opinion. Got the original my first try, so that was pretty satisfying. :)
